name: Keller Group plc
summary: Keller Group plc provides specialist geotechnical services in North America, Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific. The company offers ground engineering solutions, including ground improvement services, grouting, deep foundations, earth retention, marine, and instrumentation and monitoring services, as well as post-tension systems and industrial services. It also provides bearing capacity/ settlement control, low carbon construction, containment, excavation support, stabilization, marine structures, seepage control, slope stabilization, and monitoring solutions.
